description: Add several creators as manual matches to a campaign in one call. Each creator is a profileId and fitScore pick: the id and fitScore of a search_creators creator, or the profileId and fitScore of a get_list creator. Idempotent on (campaign, profileId). Stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of each catalog profile, so a creator carries nothing else, and any other key on a creator fails the call with a validation error. A profileId outside the catalog fails the call with a tool error naming it, and nothing is added. Returns added, the count of new matches, and present, the count already on the campaign, with addedCreators and presentCreators, the same counts per person, so a person with two matched profiles counts once. A campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. While a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, it returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

creators.description: The creators to add to the campaign: the profileId and fitScore of each, the id and fitScore of a search_creators creator or the profileId and fitScore of a get_list creator

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

name: add_campaign_matches
